name: VDC CWL31 Mwyndy Cross data centre
notes: Rhondda Cynon Taf Planning & Development Committee report for application 25/0138/FUL recommends approval for a data centre building with electrical/mechanical plant, substation, access, landscaping and drainage on land east of A4119 at Mwyndy Cross. Public reporting says the RCT planning committee approved the application. Capacity not disclosed; building footprint stated as 2,140 sqm.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Maska Group Mwyndy Cross data centre
notes: DCD and local reporting describe a Maska Group planning application filed with RCT Borough Council for a two-story 18,220 sqm data centre plus a 2,260 sqm office block, servicing/energy plant and chillers on vacant land east of the A4119 at Mwyndy Cross. Proposed IT capacity and power source were not detailed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: GCRE Energy & Data Centre Opportunity
developer: Global Centre of Rail Excellence Ltd
notes: Sell2Wales speculative notice says GCRE is seeking an Energy and Data Centre Partner for its 700 ha site, with a mandatory proposal to acquire up to about 80 ha on a 999-year lease to develop data centre assets; delivery locations include Powys. GCRE's June 2026 update says bidders are in dialogue and a partner is expected by end-2026. Capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Shared Resource Service Blaenavon data centre
developer: Shared Resource Service / Torfaen County Borough Council partners
notes: Public sources describe the Shared Resource Service as having a physical Shared Resource Centre in Blaenavon, Torfaen County Borough, housing an on-premise data centre used by the wider Welsh public sector. The 2022 source says partners decided to consolidate ageing on-premise data centres at Newport, Blaenau Gwent and Torfaen into Vantage CWL1; legacy centres were to be decommissioned after migration. Original capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Vantage Data Centre Bro Tathan
notes: St Athan Community Council and CarneySweeney report that the Vantage Data Centre at Bro Tathan, Vale of Glamorgan was approved at committee for 120MW of data storage. Planning services source identifies Vantage Data Centers as client and says the development is at Bro Tathan in South Wales.

name: Aston Martin St Athan data centre and comms room fit-out
notes: Sell2Wales notice for Aston Martin's St Athan facility described a requirement for a new data centre and comms room facility and sought supplier interest for a forthcoming RFQ. Later status and capacity were not found in public sources during this pass.
